description: FNPF 2D Kennedy breaking (A 350 2) on steep 5th-order Stokes waves in deep water (H 0.2 m, T 1.2 s, d 2 m), steepness threshold lowered (A 355 0.25) so that the deep-water flag fires early. Before fnpf breaking 01 the 2D deep-water flag was cleared in the step it was set (no viscosity, the run blows up at t = 13.6 s).
